                residue = key_fn(r, c) % period
                if residue in motif and motif[residue] != color:
                    break
                motif[residue] = color
            else:
                candidates.append((period, key_fn, motif))
                break
    period, key_fn, motif = min(candidates, key=lambda item: item[0])
    known = sorted(motif)
    for residue in range(period):
        if residue not in motif:
            near = min(known, key=lambda k: min((residue-k) % period,
                                                (k-residue) % period))
            motif[residue] = motif[near]
    return [[motif[key_fn(r, c) % period] for c in range(w)]
            for r in range(h)]
